title: moss 로그인 전 첫 화면 — 떠다니는 카드 히어로
sub: 시안 3개, 각 1440×900. 액자를 누르면 크게 보인다. 시안은 라이트 단일이다 — moss 토큰에 다크가 없어 스위치를 눌러도 시안 안은 안 바뀐다.

<style>

</style></head><body>
<div id="fit">
  <svg id="lines" viewBox="0 0 1440 900"></svg>
  <div id="cards"></div>
  <div id="veil"></div>
  <div id="hero">
    <div class="wm"><i></i>moss</div>
    <h1 id="h1"></h1>
    <button class="btn"><span class="g">G</span>Google로 계속</button>
    <a class="mail" href="#">메일로 계속</a>
    <div id="hint" hidden>카드를 끌어 보세요</div>
  </div>
</div>
<script>
const MODE='a', W=1440, H=900;
const fit=document.getElementById('fit'); let S=1;
function rescale(){S=innerWidth/W;fit.style.transform='scale('+S+')';}
addEventListener('resize',rescale); rescale();

document.getElementById('h1').innerHTML = MODE==='b'
  ? '흩어 놓아도 괜찮아요.<br>연결은 moss가 이어 줄게요'
  : '생각을 붙이면,<br>연결이 보여요';
if(MODE==='b'){document.getElementById('hint').hidden=false;fit.classList.add('drag');}

// [그룹, 종류, 색, 내용...]  그룹은 C안에서 모이는 덩어리 번호다
const D=[
 [0,'photo','','제주 협재','linear-gradient(170deg,#dfe6dc 0 30%,#a9c2b6 30% 55%,#eadcbe 55%,#d6c09a)'],
 [0,'check','','여행 짐',['여권',1],['충전기',1],['우산',0]],
 [0,'link','','제주 맛집 지도','map.naver.com','#5f9b6a'],
 [0,'hand','yellow','렌터카 예약 잊지 말기'],
 [0,'note','','비행기 금요일 7:10 출발'],
 [1,'photo','','10월 산책 코스','linear-gradient(170deg,#f2d9a8,#d9914f 55%,#8b5a3c)'],
 [1,'photo','','베란다 수국','radial-gradient(circle at 40% 40%,#ead0de,#c79dba 45%,#93a68c 80%)'],
 [1,'hand','lime','아이디어는 산책할 때 온다'],
 [1,'note','purple','좋아하는 단어: 윤슬'],
 [2,'check','','이사 준비',['인터넷 이전 신청',1],['관리비 정산',0],['화분 옮기기',0]],
 [2,'note','','관리사무소 전화는 10시 이후'],
 [2,'photo','','새 집 거실','linear-gradient(180deg,#f1eadf 0 58%,#cdb99c 58%)'],
 [2,'board','','새 집 가구','카드 8장'],
 [2,'hand','yellow','화분은 직접 옮기기'],
 [3,'check','','읽을 책',['아주 작은 습관의 힘',1],['도둑맞은 집중력',0]],
 [3,'link','','기록하는 습관을 만드는 3가지 방법','brunch.co.kr','#2c2e33'],
 [3,'note','lime','다음 분기 목표: 매주 글 1편'],
 [3,'hand','','천천히, 그래도 매일'],
 [3,'link','','회고 템플릿','notion.so','#6a6c72'],
 [4,'note','','회의 끝나고 질문 2개 정리해서 보내기'],
 [4,'note','blue','발표 슬라이드 7장을 5장으로'],
 [4,'photo','','화이트보드 사진','repeating-linear-gradient(8deg,transparent 0 22px,rgba(90,110,90,.35) 22px 24px),linear-gradient(#f5f4f0,#e2dfd7)'],
 [4,'board','','3분기 회고','카드 14장'],
 [5,'note','yellow','토요일 장보기 전에 냉장고 먼저 확인'],
 [5,'hand','','고양이 사료 주문'],
 [5,'note','purple','엄마 생신 선물 — 스카프? 찻잔?'],
 [5,'photo','','망원동 카페 메뉴판','linear-gradient(150deg,#6b4a36,#a87d5a 60%,#e8d5bb)'],
 [5,'link','','15분 집밥 레시피','youtube.com','#c4544a'],
];
const WID={note:170,hand:168,check:188,photo:176,link:196,board:172};
function inner(d){
  const [, t,, a, b, c] = d;
  if(t==='note'||t==='hand') return '<p>'+a+'</p>';
  if(t==='check') return '<b>'+a+'</b><ul>'+d.slice(4).map(x=>'<li class="'+(x[1]?'on':'')+'">'+x[0]+'</li>').join('')+'</ul>';
  if(t==='photo') return '<div class="ph" style="background:'+b+'"></div><span>'+a+'</span>';
  if(t==='link') return '<small><span class="fav" style="background:'+c+'">'+b[0].toUpperCase()+'</span>'+b+'</small><p>'+a+'</p>';
  if(t==='board') return '<div class="bd"><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i></div><b>'+a+'</b><small>'+b+'</small>';
}

// 시드 고정 난수 — 세 안이 같은 흩어짐에서 출발한다
let seed=7; const R=()=>((seed=(seed*16807)%2147483647)/2147483647);
const host=document.getElementById('cards'); const cards_tmp=[];
const cards=D.map((d,i)=>{
  const el=document.createElement('div');
  el.className='card '+d[1]+' '+d[2]; el.style.width=WID[d[1]]+'px'; el.innerHTML=inner(d);
  host.appendChild(el);
  let x,y,k=0;
  do{ x=-30+R()*(W-150); y=-20+R()*(H-110); k++; }
  while(((x+90-720)/470)**2+((y+70-450)/280)**2<1 || (k<300 && placed(x,y)));
  const z=0.66+R()*0.42;
  if(z<0.78) el.classList.add('far');
  el.style.zIndex=Math.round(z*100);
  const c={el,g:d[0],x,y,r:(R()-.5)*22,z,ph:R()*6.28,sp:.7+R()*.6,vx:0,vy:0};
  cards_tmp.push([x,y]); return c;
});
function placed(x,y){return cards_tmp.some(p=>Math.hypot(p[0]-x,p[1]-y)<125);}
cards.forEach(c=>{c.w=c.el.offsetWidth;c.h=c.el.offsetHeight;});

const reduce=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
function float(c,t,amp){
  if(reduce) return [0,0,0];
  return [Math.sin(t*.00023*c.sp+c.ph)*amp, Math.cos(t*.00029*c.sp+c.ph*1.3)*amp*1.3, Math.sin(t*.00019+c.ph)*2];
}
function put(c,x,y,r,s){c.el.style.transform='translate('+x+'px,'+y+'px) rotate('+r+'deg) scale('+s+')';}

// ---- B: 집어 던지기
let held=null, zTop=500, off=[0,0], last=[];
if(MODE==='b'){
  host.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
    const el=e.target.closest('.card'); if(!el) return;
    held=cards.find(c=>c.el===el); el.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    el.classList.add('held'); el.style.zIndex=++zTop;
    const p=pt(e); off=[p[0]-held.x,p[1]-held.y]; last=[[p[0],p[1],performance.now()]];
    held.vx=held.vy=0;
    document.getElementById('hint').style.opacity=0;
  });
  host.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{
    if(!held) return; const p=pt(e);
    held.x=p[0]-off[0]; held.y=p[1]-off[1];
    last.push([p[0],p[1],performance.now()]); if(last.length>5) last.shift();
  });
  const up=()=>{
    if(!held) return;
    const a=last[0], b=last[last.length-1], dt=Math.max(16,b[2]-a[2]);
    held.vx=(b[0]-a[0])/dt*16; held.vy=(b[1]-a[1])/dt*16;
    held.el.classList.remove('held'); held.el.classList.remove('far'); held=null;
  };
  host.addEventListener('pointerup',up); host.addEventListener('pointercancel',up);
}
function pt(e){const b=fit.getBoundingClientRect();return [(e.clientX-b.left)/S,(e.clientY-b.top)/S];}

// ---- C: 모였다 흩어진다
const svg=document.getElementById('lines');
const CL=[[250,185],[720,170],[1190,185],[250,720],[720,730],[1190,720]];
const NAMES=['여행 계획','산책','이사 준비','읽고 쓰기','회사','집'];
const labs=NAMES.map((n,i)=>{const l=document.createElement('div');l.className='lab';l.textContent=n;
  l.style.left=(CL[i][0]-40)+'px';l.style.top=CL[i][1]-150+'px';fit.insertBefore(l,host);return l;});
if(MODE==='c'){
  const by={}; cards.forEach(c=>(by[c.g]=by[c.g]||[]).push(c));
  Object.values(by).forEach(list=>list.forEach((c,j)=>{
    const col=j%3, row=Math.floor(j/3), n=Math.min(3,list.length-row*3);
    c.tx=CL[c.g][0]+(col-(n-1)/2)*150-c.w/2; c.ty=CL[c.g][1]+(row-.5)*112-c.h/2+ (list.length<=3?60:0);
    c.tr=(R()-.5)*5;
  }));
  // 덩어리 안은 사슬로, 덩어리 사이는 둘만 잇는다
  var links=[]; Object.values(by).forEach(l=>{for(let j=1;j<l.length;j++) links.push([l[j-1],l[j]]);});
  links.push([by[1][0],by[0][0]],[by[4][0],by[3][1]],[by[2][4],by[1][2]]);
  svg.innerHTML=links.map(()=>'<path pathLength="1" stroke-dasharray="1" stroke-dashoffset="1"/>').join('');
  var paths=[...svg.children];
}
const ease=p=>p<.5?4*p*p*p:1-Math.pow(-2*p+2,3)/2;
const CYCLE=14000;

function frame(t){
  if(MODE==='c'){
    const u=t%CYCLE;
    // 0~2.5초 흩어짐, 2.5~4.3초 모임, 4.3~5.3초 선, 11초까지 머묾, 11~13초 다시 흩어짐
    let g = u<2500?0 : u<4300?ease((u-2500)/1800) : u<11000?1 : u<13000?1-ease((u-11000)/2000) : 0;
    cards.forEach((c,i)=>{
      const gi=Math.max(0,Math.min(1, u<11000 ? (g*1.25-i*.009) : g));
      const f=float(c,t,14*(1-gi)+2*gi);
      const x=c.x+(c.tx-c.x)*gi+f[0], y=c.y+(c.ty-c.y)*gi+f[1];
      c.cx=x+c.w/2; c.cy=y+c.h/2; c.el.classList.toggle('far', c.z<0.78 && gi<.5);
      c.el.style.zIndex = gi>.5 ? 200+i : Math.round(c.z*100);
      put(c,x,y,c.r+(c.tr-c.r)*gi+f[2]*(1-gi), c.z+(0.84-c.z)*gi);
    });
    const lp = u<4300?0 : u<5300?(u-4300)/1000 : u<11000?1 : u<11600?1-(u-11000)/600 : 0;
    paths.forEach((p,k)=>{const [a,b]=links[k];
      const mx=(a.cx+b.cx)/2, my=(a.cy+b.cy)/2-Math.abs(a.cx-b.cx)*.12;
      p.setAttribute('d','M'+a.cx+' '+a.cy+' Q'+mx+' '+my+' '+b.cx+' '+b.cy);
      p.setAttribute('stroke-dashoffset', u>=11000 ? 0 : 1-Math.min(1,Math.max(0,lp*1.3-k*.012)));
      p.style.opacity = u>=11000 ? lp : 1;
    });
    labs.forEach(l=>l.style.opacity = lp>.6&&u<11000 ? 1 : 0);
  } else {
    cards.forEach(c=>{
      if(MODE==='b' && c!==held && (Math.abs(c.vx)>.05||Math.abs(c.vy)>.05)){
        c.x+=c.vx; c.y+=c.vy; c.vx*=.94; c.vy*=.94;
        if(c.x<-c.w*.4||c.x>W-c.w*.6){c.vx*=-.6;c.x=Math.max(-c.w*.4,Math.min(W-c.w*.6,c.x));}
        if(c.y<-c.h*.4||c.y>H-c.h*.6){c.vy*=-.6;c.y=Math.max(-c.h*.4,Math.min(H-c.h*.6,c.y));}
      }
      const isH=c===held, f=isH?[0,0,0]:float(c,t,14);
      put(c,c.x+f[0],c.y+f[1],isH?c.r*.3:c.r+f[2],isH?c.z*1.06:c.z);
    });
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>
</body></html>

];
const WID={note:170,hand:168,check:188,photo:176,link:196,board:172};
function inner(d){
  const [, t,, a, b, c] = d;
  if(t==='note'||t==='hand') return '<p>'+a+'</p>';
  if(t==='check') return '<b>'+a+'</b><ul>'+d.slice(4).map(x=>'<li class="'+(x[1]?'on':'')+'">'+x[0]+'</li>').join('')+'</ul>';
  if(t==='photo') return '<div class="ph" style="background:'+b+'"></div><span>'+a+'</span>';
  if(t==='link') return '<small><span class="fav" style="background:'+c+'">'+b[0].toUpperCase()+'</span>'+b+'</small><p>'+a+'</p>';
  if(t==='board') return '<div class="bd"><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i></div><b>'+a+'</b><small>'+b+'</small>';

const host=document.getElementById('cards'); const cards_tmp=[];
const cards=D.map((d,i)=>{
  const el=document.createElement('div');
  el.className='card '+d[1]+' '+d[2]; el.style.width=WID[d[1]]+'px'; el.innerHTML=inner(d);
  host.appendChild(el);
  let x,y,k=0;
  do{ x=-30+R()*(W-150); y=-20+R()*(H-110); k++; }
  while(((x+90-720)/470)**2+((y+70-450)/280)**2<1 || (k<300 && placed(x,y)));
  const z=0.66+R()*0.42;
  if(z<0.78) el.classList.add('far');
  el.style.zIndex=Math.round(z*100);
  const c={el,g:d[0],x,y,r:(R()-.5)*22,z,ph:R()*6.28,sp:.7+R()*.6,vx:0,vy:0};
  cards_tmp.push([x,y]); return c;
});

    held.vx=held.vy=0;
    document.getElementById('hint').style.opacity=0;
  });
  host.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{
    if(!held) return; const p=pt(e);
    held.x=p[0]-off[0]; held.y=p[1]-off[1];
    last.push([p[0],p[1],performance.now()]); if(last.length>5) last.shift();

    if(!held) return;

    c.tx=CL[c.g][0]+(col-(n-1)/2)*150-c.w/2; c.ty=CL[c.g][1]+(row-.5)*112-c.h/2+ (list.length<=3?60:0);

  var links=[]; Object.values(by).forEach(l=>{for(let j=1;j<l.length;j++) links.push([l[j-1],l[j]]);});
  links.push([by[1][0],by[0][0]],[by[4][0],by[3][1]],[by[2][4],by[1][2]]);
  svg.innerHTML=links.map(()=>'<path pathLength="1" stroke-dasharray="1" stroke-dashoffset="1"/>').join('');

  if(MODE==='c'){
    const u=t%CYCLE;
    // 0~2.5초 흩어짐, 2.5~4.3초 모임, 4.3~5.3초 선, 11초까지 머묾, 11~13초 다시 흩어짐
    let g = u<2500?0 : u<4300?ease((u-2500)/1800) : u<11000?1 : u<13000?1-ease((u-11000)/2000) : 0;
    cards.forEach((c,i)=>{
      const gi=Math.max(0,Math.min(1, u<11000 ? (g*1.25-i*.009) : g));
      const f=float(c,t,14*(1-gi)+2*gi);
      const x=c.x+(c.tx-c.x)*gi+f[0], y=c.y+(c.ty-c.y)*gi+f[1];
      c.cx=x+c.w/2; c.cy=y+c.h/2; c.el.classList.toggle('far', c.z<0.78 && gi<.5);
      c.el.style.zIndex = gi>.5 ? 200+i : Math.round(c.z*100);
      put(c,x,y,c.r+(c.tr-c.r)*gi+f[2]*(1-gi), c.z+(0.84-c.z)*gi);
    });
    const lp = u<4300?0 : u<5300?(u-4300)/1000 : u<11000?1 : u<11600?1-(u-11000)/600 : 0;
    paths.forEach((p,k)=>{const [a,b]=links[k];
      const mx=(a.cx+b.cx)/2, my=(a.cy+b.cy)/2-Math.abs(a.cx-b.cx)*.12;
      p.setAttribute('d','M'+a.cx+' '+a.cy+' Q'+mx+' '+my+' '+b.cx+' '+b.cy);

      p.style.opacity = u>=11000 ? lp : 1;
    });
    labs.forEach(l=>l.style.opacity = lp>.6&&u<11000 ? 1 : 0);
  } else {
    cards.forEach(c=>{
      if(MODE==='b' && c!==held && (Math.abs(c.vx)>.05||Math.abs(c.vy)>.05)){
        c.x+=c.vx; c.y+=c.vy; c.vx*=.94; c.vy*=.94;

      }
      const isH=c===held, f=isH?[0,0,0]:float(c,t,14);
      put(c,c.x+f[0],c.y+f[1],isH?c.r*.3:c.r+f[2],isH?c.z*1.06:c.z);
    });
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}

 [3,'hand','','천천히, 그래도 매일'],
 [3,'link','','회고 템플릿','notion.so','#6a6c72'],
 [4,'note','','회의 끝나고 질문 2개 정리해서 보내기'],
 [4,'note','blue','발표 슬라이드 7장을 5장으로'],
 [4,'photo','','화이트보드 사진','repeating-linear-gradient(8deg,transparent 0 22px,rgba(90,110,90,.35) 22px 24px),linear-gradient(#f5f4f0,#e2dfd7)'],
 [4,'board','','3분기 회고','카드 14장'],
 [5,'note','yellow','토요일 장보기 전에 냉장고 먼저 확인'],
 [5,'hand','','고양이 사료 주문'],
 [5,'note','purple','엄마 생신 선물 — 스카프? 찻잔?'],
 [5,'photo','','망원동 카페 메뉴판','linear-gradient(150deg,#6b4a36,#a87d5a 60%,#e8d5bb)'],
 [5,'link','','15분 집밥 레시피','youtube.com','#c4544a'],
];
const WID={note:170,hand:168,check:188,photo:176,link:196,board:172};
function inner(d){
  const [, t,, a, b, c] = d;
  if(t==='note'||t==='hand') return '<p>'+a+'</p>';
  if(t==='check') return '<b>'+a+'</b><ul>'+d.slice(4).map(x=>'<li class="'+(x[1]?'on':'')+'">'+x[0]+'</li>').join('')+'</ul>';
  if(t==='photo') return '<div class="ph" style="background:'+b+'"></div><span>'+a+'</span>';
  if(t==='link') return '<small><span class="fav" style="background:'+c+'">'+b[0].toUpperCase()+'</span>'+b+'</small><p>'+a+'</p>';
  if(t==='board') return '<div class="bd"><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i></div><b>'+a+'</b><small>'+b+'</small>';
}

// 시드 고정 난수 — 세 안이 같은 흩어짐에서 출발한다
let seed=7; const R=()=>((seed=(seed*16807)%2147483647)/2147483647);
const host=document.getElementById('cards'); const cards_tmp=[];
const cards=D.map((d,i)=>{
  const el=document.createElement('div');
  el.className='card '+d[1]+' '+d[2]; el.style.width=WID[d[1]]+'px'; el.innerHTML=inner(d);
  host.appendChild(el);
  let x,y,k=0;
  do{ x=-30+R()*(W-150); y=-20+R()*(H-110); k++; }
  while(((x+90-720)/470)**2+((y+70-450)/280)**2<1 || (k<300 && placed(x,y)));
  const z=0.66+R()*0.42;
  if(z<0.78) el.classList.add('far');
  el.style.zIndex=Math.round(z*100);
  const c={el,g:d[0],x,y,r:(R()-.5)*22,z,ph:R()*6.28,sp:.7+R()*.6,vx:0,vy:0};
  cards_tmp.push([x,y]); return c;
});
function placed(x,y){return cards_tmp.some(p=>Math.hypot(p[0]-x,p[1]-y)<125);}
cards.forEach(c=>{c.w=c.el.offsetWidth;c.h=c.el.offsetHeight;});

const reduce=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
function float(c,t,amp){
  if(reduce) return [0,0,0];
  return [Math.sin(t*.00023*c.sp+c.ph)*amp, Math.cos(t*.00029*c.sp+c.ph*1.3)*amp*1.3, Math.sin(t*.00019+c.ph)*2];
}
function put(c,x,y,r,s){c.el.style.transform='translate('+x+'px,'+y+'px) rotate('+r+'deg) scale('+s+')';}

// ---- B: 집어 던지기
let held=null, zTop=500, off=[0,0], last=[];
if(MODE==='b'){
  host.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
    const el=e.target.closest('.card'); if(!el) return;
    held=cards.find(c=>c.el===el); el.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    el.classList.add('held'); el.style.zIndex=++zTop;
    const p=pt(e); off=[p[0]-held.x,p[1]-held.y]; last=[[p[0],p[1],performance.now()]];
    held.vx=held.vy=0;
    document.getElementById('hint').style.opacity=0;
  });
  host.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{
    if(!held) return; const p=pt(e);
    held.x=p[0]-off[0]; held.y=p[1]-off[1];
    last.push([p[0],p[1],performance.now()]); if(last.length>5) last.shift();
  });
  const up=()=>{
    if(!held) return;
    const a=last[0], b=last[last.length-1], dt=Math.max(16,b[2]-a[2]);
    held.vx=(b[0]-a[0])/dt*16; held.vy=(b[1]-a[1])/dt*16;
    held.el.classList.remove('held'); held.el.classList.remove('far'); held=null;
  };
  host.addEventListener('pointerup',up); host.addEventListener('pointercancel',up);
}
function pt(e){const b=fit.getBoundingClientRect();return [(e.clientX-b.left)/S,(e.clientY-b.top)/S];}

// ---- C: 모였다 흩어진다
const svg=document.getElementById('lines');
const CL=[[250,185],[720,170],[1190,185],[250,720],[720,730],[1190,720]];
const NAMES=['여행 계획','산책','이사 준비','읽고 쓰기','회사','집'];
const labs=NAMES.map((n,i)=>{const l=document.createElement('div');l.className='lab';l.textContent=n;
  l.style.left=(CL[i][0]-40)+'px';l.style.top=CL[i][1]-150+'px';fit.insertBefore(l,host);return l;});
if(MODE==='c'){
  const by={}; cards.forEach(c=>(by[c.g]=by[c.g]||[]).push(c));
  Object.values(by).forEach(list=>list.forEach((c,j)=>{
    const col=j%3, row=Math.floor(j/3), n=Math.min(3,list.length-row*3);
    c.tx=CL[c.g][0]+(col-(n-1)/2)*150-c.w/2; c.ty=CL[c.g][1]+(row-.5)*112-c.h/2+ (list.length<=3?60:0);
    c.tr=(R()-.5)*5;
  }));
  // 덩어리 안은 사슬로, 덩어리 사이는 둘만 잇는다
  var links=[]; Object.values(by).forEach(l=>{for(let j=1;j<l.length;j++) links.push([l[j-1],l[j]]);});
  links.push([by[1][0],by[0][0]],[by[4][0],by[3][1]],[by[2][4],by[1][2]]);
  svg.innerHTML=links.map(()=>'<path pathLength="1" stroke-dasharray="1" stroke-dashoffset="1"/>').join('');
  var paths=[...svg.children];
}
const ease=p=>p<.5?4*p*p*p:1-Math.pow(-2*p+2,3)/2;
const CYCLE=14000;

function frame(t){
  if(MODE==='c'){
    const u=t%CYCLE;
    // 0~2.5초 흩어짐, 2.5~4.3초 모임, 4.3~5.3초 선, 11초까지 머묾, 11~13초 다시 흩어짐
    let g = u<2500?0 : u<4300?ease((u-2500)/1800) : u<11000?1 : u<13000?1-ease((u-11000)/2000) : 0;
    cards.forEach((c,i)=>{
      const gi=Math.max(0,Math.min(1, u<11000 ? (g*1.25-i*.009) : g));
      const f=float(c,t,14*(1-gi)+2*gi);
      const x=c.x+(c.tx-c.x)*gi+f[0], y=c.y+(c.ty-c.y)*gi+f[1];
      c.cx=x+c.w/2; c.cy=y+c.h/2; c.el.classList.toggle('far', c.z<0.78 && gi<.5);
      c.el.style.zIndex = gi>.5 ? 200+i : Math.round(c.z*100);
      put(c,x,y,c.r+(c.tr-c.r)*gi+f[2]*(1-gi), c.z+(0.84-c.z)*gi);
    });
    const lp = u<4300?0 : u<5300?(u-4300)/1000 : u<11000?1 : u<11600?1-(u-11000)/600 : 0;
    paths.forEach((p,k)=>{const [a,b]=links[k];
      const mx=(a.cx+b.cx)/2, my=(a.cy+b.cy)/2-Math.abs(a.cx-b.cx)*.12;
      p.setAttribute('d','M'+a.cx+' '+a.cy+' Q'+mx+' '+my+' '+b.cx+' '+b.cy);
      p.setAttribute('stroke-dashoffset', u>=11000 ? 0 : 1-Math.min(1,Math.max(0,lp*1.3-k*.012)));
      p.style.opacity = u>=11000 ? lp : 1;
    });
    labs.forEach(l=>l.style.opacity = lp>.6&&u<11000 ? 1 : 0);
  } else {
    cards.forEach(c=>{
      if(MODE==='b' && c!==held && (Math.abs(c.vx)>.05||Math.abs(c.vy)>.05)){
        c.x+=c.vx; c.y+=c.vy; c.vx*=.94; c.vy*=.94;
        if(c.x<-c.w*.4||c.x>W-c.w*.6){c.vx*=-.6;c.x=Math.max(-c.w*.4,Math.min(W-c.w*.6,c.x));}
        if(c.y<-c.h*.4||c.y>H-c.h*.6){c.vy*=-.6;c.y=Math.max(-c.h*.4,Math.min(H-c.h*.6,c.y));}
      }
      const isH=c===held, f=isH?[0,0,0]:float(c,t,14);
      put(c,c.x+f[0],c.y+f[1],isH?c.r*.3:c.r+f[2],isH?c.z*1.06:c.z);
    });
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>
